scripts.update: bun run clean && bun run download && bun run generate && bun run build
scripts.clean:svg: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do scripts delete svg --symbols --in svg/$w; done
scripts.download: bun run download:font && bun run download:fonts && bun run download:svg && bun run download:metadata && bun run copy:metadata
scripts.download:fonts: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do scripts download font --symbols --evergreen --weight $w --grade 0 --size 48 --to font/$w; done
scripts.download:svg: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do scripts download svg --symbols --weight $w --to svg/$w; done
scripts.generate: bun run generate:types && bun run copy:types
scripts.copy:types: set -eu; for w in 100 200 300 400 500 600 700; do cp material-symbols/index.d.ts font/$w; done
scripts.build: bun run build:font && bun run build:svg
scripts.bump: set -eu; : "${VERSION:?set VERSION=<x.y.z>}"; for w in material-symbols font/100 font/200 font/300 font/400 font/500 font/600 font/700 svg/100 svg/200 svg/300 svg/400 svg/500 svg/600 svg/700 metadata; do if [ -f $w/package.json ]; then (cd $w && bun pm version "$VERSION" --no-git-tag-version); fi; done; bun install && bun run git-commit-tag
scripts.publish: set -eu; for w in material-symbols font/100 font/200 font/300 font/400 font/500 font/600 font/700 svg/100 svg/200 svg/300 svg/400 svg/500 svg/600 svg/700 metadata; do if [ -f $w/package.json ]; then (cd $w && bun publish); fi; done
